descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Play music, build worlds, and live experiences together in VR

PatchWorld is a multiplayer audiovisual playground where creators make music, build interactive worlds, design instruments, create reactive visuals, and invent playful systems in VR _ no coding needed.

Explore ready-made worlds, jam rooms, interactive stories, community creations, live events, and playful experiments, or invent something entirely new.

**For curious and creative minds of all kinds:** VR creators, world builders, musicians, producers, visual artists, performers, educators, streamers, and explorers.

[media]


# Hang out, build, jam & explore

Play and create with others in real time. Explore community worlds. Attend live events, workshops, jams and performances. Share your creations and remix what others have built.

[media]


# Customize everything 

Import custom VRM avatars, design reactive costumes, and create your own movement systems.

[media]


# Build your own systems _ no coding

Use blocks to create:

- Interactive worlds, games, and playful toys

[media]

- Musical instruments, synths, sequencers, and full music studios

[media]

- Physics experiments and motion-based interactions

[media]

- VJ tools and real-time audiovisual effects

[media]


# Import or generate assets

Use the web portal to bring your own sounds, images, 3D, or generate new assets in VR with AI tools.

[media]

# Connect your setup

Go further with recording tools, spatial audio, MIDI, OSC, Ableton Link, and connections to your real-world setup.

[media]

Join our Discord for community support, and learn through our Wiki and workshops.

[media]
